name: Otoko no Musume Yakyuuken！
source:
A Baseball Rock-Paper-Scissors Game Where You Strip a Boy
The game ends when your life (money) reaches 0.
Win a round of rock-paper-scissors to make him take off one piece of clothing.
Once he’s completely naked, dress him up in women’s clothes and have sex!
translation:
一场棒球剪刀石头布游戏，你要剥掉男孩的衣服
当你的生命（金钱）达到0时游戏结束。
赢得一轮剪刀石头布，让他脱掉一件衣服。
一旦他完全赤身裸体，给他穿上女装并发生性关系！
